bestiary.isekai_mahou.world_events_alien: Foot soldier of the invaders that come with meteors. Charges and claws; its slime slows you.
Small, fast and always in a pack. Leaps at your face. Afraid of fire.
Leads the meteor invasion. A pulse around it, a straight beam, and larvae when wounded - all telegraphed on the ground. Light hurts it; shadow barely does. Drops an Alien Core.
Stays back and fires plasma in a straight line. The green strip on the ground warns you: step aside.
